name: glm-5.3-flash-uncensored-fp8.h200-8gpu
notes: 8x H200 (1.13 TB) TP8 — official vLLM recipe target for GLM-5.3-Flash. FP8 abliterated GLM-5.3-Flash (glm5_next, 321B/18B-active MoE, multimodal, 1M native ctx). 305.8 GiB weights leave ~800 GB for KV cache; 512K context at 64 concurrent seqs (raise max_num_seqs / max_model_len toward 1M as headroom allows). Requires vllm/vllm-openai:glm53-flash image (vLLM 0.29+, FlashInfer >=0.6.17).
